title: [1hr Talk] Intro to Large Language Models

goals.A: Understand how large language models are trained, from pretraining on internet text to fine-tuning them into assistants.
goals.B: Learn about security attacks on language models, such as jailbreaks, prompt injection and data poisoning.
goals.C: Understand how language models use tools like a web browser, a calculator and code execution, and the idea of an LLM operating system.

title: Transformers, the tech behind LLMs | Deep Learning Chapter 5

goals.A: Understand how word embeddings represent meaning as directions in a high-dimensional space.
goals.B: Understand how the softmax function and temperature turn the model's final outputs into a probability distribution.
goals.C: Understand the general deep learning background: model weights, parameters and matrix-vector multiplication.

title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course

goals.A: Learn how to install Git and connect it to GitHub using SSH keys.
goals.B: Learn how branches work and how to merge them, including resolving merge conflicts.
goals.C: Learn how to undo changes and mistakes, for example with git reset.
